purpose: MAX/OpenClaw/Hermes/Harry/Codex/M3 triage and self-heal routing matrix.
phase1_rule: Design and validate only; do not execute repair actions in Phase 1.

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect MAX routes, registry, reports, and logs without printing secrets.
components.failure_symptoms: Stale answers, wrong routing, overclaims, missing approval gate.
components.repair_path: Codex patch after plan approval; Hermes audit.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION
components.audit_requirement: Hermes audit for routing or approval changes.

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Check health gate, worker heartbeat, queue stats, and task metadata without mutation.
components.failure_symptoms: Stale heartbeat, unaudited backlog, blocked delegation, unsafe git capability.
components.repair_path: Queue audit and worker repair after approval.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION or APPROVE SERVICE RESTART depending action

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect local dashboard/gateway process and audit artifacts.
components.failure_symptoms: No local audit path, stale context, failed support path.
components.repair_path: Local repair or restart after approval.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE SERVICE RESTART if restart is needed
components.audit_requirement: Founder or Codex validates restored audit path.

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Check OpenCode process, remote/mobile access, Tailscale path.
components.failure_symptoms: Remote access unavailable, mobile checks fail.
components.required_approval_phrase: Action-specific approval

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect git status, diff, tests, and build plans.
components.failure_symptoms: Dirty unknown tree, failed tests, unsafe implementation scope.
components.repair_path: Focused patch and targeted tests after approval.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Review planning artifact freshness and contradictions.
components.failure_symptoms: Plan conflicts with runtime or approvals.
components.required_approval_phrase: None for planning only
components.audit_requirement: Hermes or Codex audit before execution.

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Host-header GETs and source/build evidence only.
components.failure_symptoms: Apex 404, operator route leak, stale landing.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION and APPROVE SERVICE RESTART if runtime restart

components.safe_read_only_health_check: GET /health, inspect routers/logs without secrets.
components.failure_symptoms: 500/404 regressions, auth/payment errors, CORS risk.
components.required_approval_phrase: Action-specific approval

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect process/config timestamps and public route behavior.
components.failure_symptoms: Public apex unavailable, wrong ingress, internal route exposure.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CLOUDFLARE/DNS CHANGE and APPROVE SERVICE RESTART

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Check public ApostApp paths and tunnel config read-only.
components.failure_symptoms: ApostApp 404/5xx, internal API exposure.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CLOUDFLARE/DNS CHANGE and APPROVE SERVICE RESTART

components.safe_read_only_health_check: DNS lookups and Cloudflare read-only inspection.
components.failure_symptoms: Wrong CNAME/A record, public host unavailable.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CLOUDFLARE/DNS CHANGE

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Check login/access behavior without printing tokens.
components.failure_symptoms: Luxe/Forge login blocked, session/user authorization issue.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CLOUDFLARE/DNS CHANGE

components.safe_read_only_health_check: No live Stripe checks unless explicitly approved; inspect code only.
components.failure_symptoms: Payment uncertainty, webhook mismatch, refund ambiguity.
components.repair_path: Hard stop until live Stripe approval.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE LIVE STRIPE ACTION

components.safe_read_only_health_check: git status/log/rev-parse with optional locks disabled.
components.failure_symptoms: Wrong branch, dirty tree, unpushed commit, OpenClaw git mutation request.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE PUSH or APPROVE MERGE TO MAIN

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect notification preferences/templates without sending.
components.failure_symptoms: Spam risk, secret leakage risk, unexpected auto-send.
components.required_approval_phrase: Explicit notification opt-in

components.safe_read_only_health_check: GET/HEAD public hosts and verify no internal exposure.
components.failure_symptoms: Apex broken, ApostApp broken, internal APIs public.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE GATE 1 EXECUTION for launch

components.safe_read_only_health_check: GET operator hosts and access boundaries.
components.failure_symptoms: Studio/Luxe/Forge/Hermes unavailable or exposed.
components.required_approval_phrase: Action-specific approval

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect module registry and routes.
components.failure_symptoms: Module overclaim, route errors.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION if code changes

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect module routes and lifecycle tests.
components.failure_symptoms: Quote/job flow regression.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION if code changes

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Check public route plan and preservation tests.
components.failure_symptoms: Public apostille routes broken, payment route risk.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION; Stripe approval for payment actions

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect protected operator route behavior.
components.failure_symptoms: Forge route leak or access failure.
components.required_approval_phrase: Action-specific approval

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect route and pricing tests.
components.failure_symptoms: Pricing route or calculator regression.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION if code changes

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect module routes and workflow tests.
components.failure_symptoms: Archive workflow unavailable or overclaimed.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION if code changes

components.safe_read_only_health_check: Inspect recovery status/routes and tests.
components.failure_symptoms: Recovery status stale or unsafe controls.
components.required_approval_phrase: APPROVE CODEX IMPLEMENTATION if code changes
